segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so quick check on the Northstar renewal. They're staying at 64 seats, adding the analytics add-on, and they want the extension to run Feb 1, 2026 through Jan 31, 2027.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Same commercial terms or did they push on price?

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Procurement asked for anything weird in the terms?

segments.text: No, just annual invoice up front and the 30-day payment language they had last time. Legal already said we can leave the indemnity section as-is.

segments.text: Are you getting them the proposal today?

segments.text: Got it. If it lands today, are they signing this week?
